notes: Landmark publication verified 2026-08-21: Vasaikar et al., Cell 2019, PMID 31031003 -- prospectively collected colon cancer cohort, paired tumor/normal proteomics+phosphoproteomics. PDC portal is a JavaScript SPA; exact study ID/case count/file inventory could not be fetched in this pass (deferred, not guessed). No download performed. PDC GraphQL API (pdc.cancer.gov/graphql, introspection disabled but `study`/`studyCatalog`/`filesPerStudy`/`getPaginatedUIPublication` queries work) queried 2026-08-26: **PDC contains two distinct CPTAC colon cohort/publication groupings relevant here, represented by four PDC study IDs.** `getPaginatedUIPublication` (PDC's own official study<->publication mapping) directly links PMID 31031003 (Vasaikar et al., Cell 2019 -- this registry's cited publication) to `PDC000109`/`PDC000116`/`PDC000117` ("Prospective Colon" trio: VU Label-Free Proteome 100 cases, PNNL TMT10 Proteome 102 cases, PNNL TMT10 Phosphoproteome 102 cases; project "CPTAC2 Confirmatory", study_submitter_id "S037-1/2/3"), independently cross-checked against Vasaikar 2019's own fetched methods text (PMC6768830: 110 patients, 100 tumor label-free, 96 TMT tumor-NAT pairs, Vanderbilt + PNNL centers). The same official mapping links `PDC000111` ("TCGA Colon Cancer Proteome", study_submitter_id "S016-1", project "CPTAC2 Retrospective", 90 patients/95 samples, Label Free) to two earlier, different publications instead: PMID 25043054 (Zhang et al., Nature 2014) and PMID 26110064 (Slebos et al., 2015) -- confirming `PDC000111` is NOT this registry's cited study. **One unresolved gap, worded precisely, no cause guessed at**: Vasaikar 2019's own text cites its data under the old (pre-PDC-migration) CPTAC Data Portal study ID "S045"; PDC's current study_submitter_id field for the matching trio instead reads "S037", and no S045-labeled entry exists anywhere in PDC's current 248-study catalog searched here. This is a legacy identifier/path discrepancy between the publication and the current data organization -- its cause (portal migration, re-numbering, or something else) is not independently resolved here. File inventory obtained for all three S037-trio studies via `filesPerStudy`: PDC000109 (2,423 files, 665.6 GB), PDC000116 (1,080 files, 519.45 GB), PDC000117 (554 files, 140.78 GB) -- overwhelmingly raw/processed mass spectra and peptide-spectrum-matches, not usable without search-engine software, but each also has a small "Protein Assembly" category of already-processed CDAP TSVs: PDC000109's `CPTAC2_Prospective_Colon_VU_Proteome.summary.tsv` (5.6 MB)/`.spectral_counts.tsv` (35.7 MB)/`.precursor_area.tsv` (75.9 MB); PDC000116's `CPTAC2_Colon_Prospective_Collection_PNNL_Proteome.summary.tsv` (2.78 MB)/`.tmt10.tsv` (54.9 MB, likely a gene/protein-level TMT10 ratio matrix analogous to what this repository already uses for `PXD055821`'s DIA-NN matrix); PDC000117's phospho equivalents. **None of these files have been downloaded or inspected for target-symbol content in this pass** -- this is a real, concrete, not-yet-pursued activation path for Module D if `CPTAC_COAD` is ever promoted out of `SUPPLEMENT_FROZEN`, surfaced here for a future explicit decision, not acted on unilaterally.
